svg.text: B1 · Garage only · boarded former research wing
4 m CLEAR + 1 m SERVICE + 0.3 m SLAB
Only the garage and necessary core circulation remain active on B1. The full-height freight
opens directly into the garage through a 2.4 m doorway, with a clear 6 m staging strip in
front. Boarded section 01 is the former mapping / signals research wing, sealed at one 1.5
m opening off the bay. No routine analysis or maintenance functions are placed on this
Concept floor plan · 50% floor tints · Symbolic stair treads / door swings · Not a construction plan
